snippet.title: Super School Day [iOS & Android]
snippet.description:
iOS:   https://itunes.apple.com/gb/app/super-school-day/id644339605
Android:  https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=air.com.secondimpactgames.SuperSchoolDay

It's here! Super School Day lets you play out the most ridiculous school day imaginable! Dress as an astronaut, time travel and save the world! Or just play dodgeball and fail your exam. There are dinosaurs, fire extinguisher powered chairs and sweet sweet dubstep wobs.

With secret characters to unlock, over 30 achievements to grab and plenty of hidden secrets to find, Super School Day will keep you bizzay!
